text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No... I can't stop here... I can't!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm a... first-rate...

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was an awesome race! I finally
got to
see Seiun Sky and Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text: They were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fidgety Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I bet they'll go to the spring Tenno
Sho,
right? Or we might even see them
at the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Fidgety Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I'm really looking forward to
seeing
what they'll do next year! They
both definitely
have my support!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so stupid.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Not a single person is looking my way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I was wrong. Maybe I shouldn't
have tried.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What a disgrace...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: B-but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: In the end, my mother was right.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't take center stage. I wasn't
even close.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm not first-rate at all...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Stop it!
choice_data_list: King Halo is a first-rate Umamusume!
King Halo is a first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't be stubborn and look at the
reality! I'm...
I'm not...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...K-Kawakami? What are you doing
here?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I came to support you! You were really
wonderful
out there!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Your powerful strides, your bursts of
speed... And
above all...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
How you keep running with that
beautiful posture
no matter what! I just
love watching you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...K-Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
King! Great job out there! You really
completed
the Triple Crown tour!

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You were so awesome! I'm gonna do my
best so I
can run the Triple Crown
someday too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You all saw me...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: Not everyone fails to see your worth.
Not everyone refuses to recognize your talent.

text_block_list.text:
Even with this loss, eyes are still on King
Halo.

No matter how frustrating things may be,
no
matter how shocked by her people
may become...
choice_data_list: I know, because I've been watching you all this time.
I know, because I've been watching you all this time.

text_block_list.text:
Even if her achievements don't satisfy
her
mother...

Even if life throws her countless
heartbreaking
moments, she will rise and
push on. She is a
tenacious Umamusume
who deserves to be
admired.

Her talent and charm are completely
different
from her mother. It's what
makes her unique.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Are you mocking me by
continuing to
repeat that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I swear! I just can't with you!
choice_data_list: I'll call you 'first-rate' as many times as it takes.
I'll call you 'first-rate' as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: ï¼ââBecause I'm one of those captivated by you, too.ï¼
(—Because I'm also one of those captivated by you.)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Dummy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're such a dummy! At times like this,
you're
supposed to lecture me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Instead, you're just hardheaded,
stubborn, and
clumsy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And above all, you're too lenient!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Seriously... It's not classy at all...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why... Why are we both such fools?

I lend her my shoulder until her tears
stop.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Before the Kikuka Sho, there was
something you
were trying to tell me,
right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Well, you can say it now.

But she's not the same as her mother.
There are
different places where her
potential can shine.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to hear it.
She looks at me intensely, waiting.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Let's stop trying to win your mother's attention.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's what you want me to stop?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're not going to tell me to quit
running long
distances?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're not going say stop running races I
can't
win and focus on what I'm good at?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: In my own way...
choice_data_list: Let's be first-rate, the King Halo way.

text_block_list.text:
King Halo shouldn't be trying to follow
in
someone else's footsteps, and she
shouldn't be
chasing after anyone's
approval.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Is it really okay for me to
do things
how I want?

Her path shouldn't be influenced by her
mother or
anyone else.
choice_data_list: Walk a path that's all your own.
Walk a path that's entirely your own.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't be first-rate for anyone else's
sake. I
should be first-rate for myself...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're right.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that.
